extraction.Name: Mary Monroe Smith
extraction.Refused/Protested: This was not explained to me and I did not know I had to pay taxes on the land.
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: This is not mortgaged. Not sold.
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: No. There are back taxes on it now. Do not have enough money now to pay back taxes.
extraction.Occupation/Income: I have not had any support from State, Government or County
extraction.NOTES: State of Nebraska, Box Butte County. Had an operation for tumor last July, not fully recovered. Mentally good. Physically fair. Land was leased to Lance Creek Livestock Co., for five years at 25¢ per acre, to be paid twice a year. They paid for only two and one-half years. After lease expired they paid $12.00 lease money; B. G. Pinney of Crawford, Nebraska, and Albert Rochelle of Tuthill, South Dakota, were stockholders and at the head of this company. No persons dependent upon her for support. Subscribed and sworn to before me this 9th day of [March], 1929.
